explanation: Almost always 0; it reaches about 10 only at the GO step where the agent switches to a2 right after a trial where it chose a1, got a rare transition to S2 and was rewarded (D1 shows "rewarded"), mostly in mid-episode trials (about 30-65), and the same switch late in the episode gives only about 0-2.
